reasoning_quality_informational.final_root_problem: CRM dispute tickets roughly doubled from a ~600/month Jun-Jul baseline to ~1220/month in Aug-Sep 2026 (F-05). Field manual-read route completion fell to 0.88 against a 0.95 target across 9200 manual-read accounts in that window (F-01); accounts without an accepted read are estimate-substituted during billing import, and estimate-substituted reads account for 41% of currently disputed bills (F-03) — confirming the field-read completion shortfall as a partial, evidenced driver of the surge. The remaining 59% of disputed bills carry an ACTUAL read (F-03) and are not explained by this mechanism. The requester's premise that slow ticket response drives the surge is contradicted: response times are within the 3.0-day SLA (F-04).
reasoning_quality_informational.ideal_final_problem: BV-17 validation rejects valid firmware-v4.2 AMI reads (unit-scale mismatch on H-MDMS-BILL) and substitutes estimates.
